nodes.label: Sand Texture
nodes.description: Minecraft-style sand block texture. Warm light yellow-beige granular surface with randomized pixel noise simulating fine sand grains. Subtle variation in pixel brightness creates a natural sandy appearance without strong directional patterning. Color palette: light sandy yellow (#D8C878), pale cream (#E0D090), medium tan (#C8B860), slightly darker grain specks (#B0A050). Game purpose: gravity-affected block found in deserts, beaches, and underwater; used for crafting sandstone, glass (when smelted), and concrete powder; also used as natural terrain filler.
nodes.pattern: randomized granular pixel noise in warm yellow-beige tones
